posts.title: Solo Parental Leave Diaries: Making Peace and Being Grateful
posts.description: Like many parents this past week, I’ve been watching in envy as other players scream up the levels in World of Warcraft: Forever. posts.title: Solo Parental Leave Diaries, Day 1: Nap Ambitions
posts.description: It's been almost four years since I had solo parental leave with my first child. So as I lay there next to my second, her overtired and letting me know it, I cursed my ambition for wanting to get her onto a three-nap schedule.
